dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: That taste, Nara Varuna once brought it up.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: A taste of it would make you feel as if swallowed the flame of Vanagni. Eeek! Even the thought of it is terrifying.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: But some Nara like that taste. They must be the bravest Nara among all.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: #Brave Nara {NICKNAME} must like "the taste of anger," no?
